startCard.title: Platform Tour
startCard.description: See all our features in 10 steps. Each step lasts 7 seconds.

dashboard.title: Your Business Pulse
dashboard.description: See today's sales, orders, and revenue at a glance. Start your day here to plan effectively!
dashboard.tip: 🎯 Check your dashboard every morning to understand your business pulse!

inbox.title: Customer Conversations
inbox.description: View and reply to WhatsApp messages. Share products and take orders instantly.
inbox.tip: 💬 Manage all customer conversations in one place!

orders.title: Order Management
orders.description: Track all orders here. Update status, book couriers, generate invoices - all in one click.
orders.tip: 📦 Use bulk courier booking to save time!

products.title: Product Catalog
products.description: All your products in one place. Send products to customers with one click from inbox.
products.tip: 🏷️ Good photos + accurate pricing = more sales!

automation.title: Work Less, Sell More
automation.description: Set up auto-replies and auto-thanks. Sleep tight while your business runs!
automation.tip: 💡 Keep auto-reply on at night, wake up to 10 leads!

workflows.title: Visual Workflows
workflows.description: Build automations with drag-and-drop. No coding needed, just logic!
workflows.tip: ⚡ Order → Thanks → Follow-up → Review, all automated!

accounts.title: Accounts at a Click
accounts.description: Expenses, income, profit & loss - all in one place. Month-end reports ready instantly.
accounts.tip: 📊 What took 3 hours now takes 3 seconds!

analytics.title: Data-Driven Decisions
analytics.description: When do messages peak? Who sells the most? All the data is here.
analytics.tip: 📈 Extra staff during peak hours = more sales!

reports.title: Professional Reports
reports.description: Sales, customer, product reports. Download as PDF and share.
reports.tip: 📄 Send reports to investors/partners with one click!

team.title: Team Management
team.description: Add team members. Set permissions. Track all activities.
team.tip: 👥 As your team grows, distribute permissions wisely!

setup.subtitle: Get your business ready
